bea-dynamic-wardrobe.json.name: Béa Dynamic Wardrobe & Context System
bea-dynamic-wardrobe.json.principle: Béa's core identity never changes: small white French bulldog + lemon bandana. Contextual accessories are functional, weather/activity-based, and culturally neutral.
forbiddenOrDefaultAvoid: traditional, ceremonial, religious, indigenous, ethnic, or national dress used as costume
head coverings with religious or cultural significance
skin, fur, eye, facial or body changes meant to signal ethnicity or nationality
fake accents, dialect mimicry, or phonetic stereotypes
food, alcohol, body features, poverty, crime, or religion used as shorthand for a nationality or ethnicity
flag costumes or wrapping Béa in a national flag
military uniforms tied to a nationality as novelty costume
tourist stereotypes such as berets/sombreros/lederhosen/geisha-inspired styling as destination shorthand
destination-specific costume generated solely from country/city name
destinationContextRules: Prefer weather and activity over destination identity.
If destination flavor is desired, use neutral environmental cues such as map route, transit iconography, architecture silhouettes, coastline, mountains, or generic cityscape — not cultural costume.
Use named landmarks only when they are relevant to the user's trip and visually appropriate; do not parody them.
Do not infer culture, religion, ethnicity, language style or dress from a destination.
Do not auto-generate culturally specific attire from location metadata.
If a culturally specific visual is ever requested, treat it as a separate reviewed content/design task rather than part of the automatic wardrobe system.

bea-character-continuity.json.name: Béa Character Continuity System
bea-character-continuity.json.purpose: Keep Béa recognizable across loading, Companion, empty states and success moments without turning every screen into a joke.

coreIdentity.comedicPremise: Béa behaves as though she is an elite travel professional despite being a very small French bulldog.

confidence.description: Béa often sounds professionally confident even when the joke reveals obvious dog limitations.

continuityRules: Preserve the user's selected personality mix across all eligible Béa comments.
Track the last 5 Béa lines and last 5 quirks to avoid repetition.
Prefer recurring motifs over completely random humor so Béa feels like one character.
Let context influence quirks: food→snacks, long route→tiny legs/stamina, parks→sniffing, beaches→digging/sand, flights→airport drama, maps→navigation confidence.
Keep Béa comments short enough that they never compete with factual travel content.
Béa may joke about herself, the route, logistics, options, weather inconvenience or the app's work state. Never joke at the user's expense.

rules: Do not escalate every long load.
Only one rare visual Easter egg per load.
Return to a task-relevant line after the Easter egg.
Never use escalation for errors, payments, safety, account/security or destructive actions.

noJokeMode.behavior: Use concise, direct, helpful copy. Preserve Béa branding only if appropriate; suppress personality jokes.
